douban.title: 高增长手册
douban.summary: 从十人团队走向大公司时，创始人会遇到哪些新的管理问题？吉尔以董事会、招人、文化等具体决策为线索，穿插创业者与经营者的访谈。
douban.editionNote: 姜昊骞译，湖南文艺出版社，2021 年，ISBN 9787572601620。

en.title: High Growth Handbook
en.summary: 知名科技高管兼天使投资人埃拉德·吉尔（Elad Gil）曾与Airbnb、Twitter、谷歌、Instacart、Coinbase、Stripe和Square等高增长科技公司合作，见证它们从初创企业成长为全球品牌。在这些成功案例中，吉尔总结出了一套可复制的成功法则，并将其凝练于《高增长手册》（High Growth Handbook）一书中。该书涵盖CEO角色、董事会管理、核心团队招募与管理、并购、IPO及后期融资等关键议题，并穿插了对硅谷巨星如领英联合创始人里德·霍夫曼（Reid Hoffman）、安德森·霍洛维茨合伙人马克·安德森（Marc Andreessen）和Box创始人亚伦·列维（Aaron Levie）等十余位业界领袖的深度访谈，为高增长初创企业的领导者和从业者解析应对最复杂挑战的清晰路径。《纽约时报》畅销书《联盟》（The Alliance）和《你自己的创业公司》（The Startup of You）的合著者里德·霍夫曼将这本指南誉为"犀利的行动指南"，称其为将初创企业打造为独角兽的终极秘籍。
en.summaryOriginal: Well-known technology executive and angel investor Elad Gil has worked with high growth tech companies like Airbnb, Twitter, Google, Instacart, Coinbase, Stripe, and Square as they've grown from small companies into global brands. Across all of these break-out companies, a set of common patterns has evolved into a repeatable playbook that Gil has codified in High Growth Handbook. Covering key topics including the role of the CEO, managing your board, recruiting and managing an executive team, M&A, IPOs and late stage funding rounds, and interspersed with over a dozen interviews with some of the biggest names in Silicon Valley including Reid Hoffman (LinkedIn), Marc Andreessen (Andreessen Horowitz), and Aaron Levie (Box), High Growth Handbook presents crystal clear guidance for navigating the most complex challenges that confront leaders and operators in high-growth startups. In what Reid Hoffman, cofounder of LinkedIn and co-author of the #1 NYT bestsellers The Alliance and The Startup of You calls "a trenchant guide," High Growth Handbook is the playbook for turning a startup into a unicorn.

episodeTitle.en: The playbook for building high talent density teams | Adam Ward, Head of Talent at Cursor
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造高人才密度的团队｜Cursor 人才负责人 Adam Ward

recommendations.scoreReason: 把它当作创始人遇到具体问题时可以随手查阅的参考书。
recommendations.quoteEn: I'm a big fan of a book where you can just jump to a chapter and get an answer, and it's not this linear piece you got to work through.
recommendations.quoteZh: 我很喜欢这种可以直接翻到某一章找到答案的书，用不着从头顺着读。

episodeTitle.en: Billion dollar failures, and billion dollar success | Tom Conrad (Quibi, Pandora, Pets.com, Zero)
episodeTitle.zh: 百亿美元的失败与百亿美元的成功 | 汤姆·康拉德（Quibi、Pandora、Pets.com、Zero）

recommendations.scoreReason: 尤其喜欢每章的实务访谈。
recommendations.quoteEn: I really love Elad Gil's High Growth Handbook.
recommendations.quoteZh: 我很喜欢埃拉德·吉尔的《高增长手册》。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Stripe | Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-COO of Stripe)
episodeTitle.zh: 从扩展Stripe中吸取的经验教训 | 克莱尔·休斯·约翰逊（Stripe前COO）

recommendations.scoreReason: 提及自己贡献的章节，也明确推荐全书。
recommendations.quoteEn: even though if you look at High Growth Handbook, which I also really do recommend not just because I'm in it
recommendations.quoteZh: 说到《高增长手册》，我也确实很推荐它，不光是因为我参与了写作。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how the New York Times builds product | Alex Hardiman (CPO, the New York Times)
episodeTitle.zh: 《纽约时报》产品内幕解析 | 亚历克斯·哈迪曼（纽约时报首席产品官）

recommendations.scoreReason: 把它列为出版后仍值得反复查阅的参考书。
recommendations.quoteEn: I love Stripe Press, and so I think a lot of the books that they have are just such good references, like Elad Gill's High Growth Handbook
recommendations.quoteZh: 我很喜欢 Stripe Press，他们的很多书都是很好的参考，比如埃拉德·吉尔的《高增长手册》。
